concerns.text: FR‑017 requires storing all final results, performance metrics, and SHAP analyses in a canonical `results.json` file. The plan creates `results/summary.json` instead, which does not match the specified filename and may break downstream expectations.

concerns.location: plan.md:Entire document (no explicit mention of SC‑006)
concerns.text: SC‑006 mandates that after processing the dataset must contain ≥ 200 rows with all required features present and no missing values. The plan never references a check or assertion of this row‑count requirement.

concerns.location: plan.md:Entire document (no explicit mention of SC‑007)
concerns.text: SC‑007 requires logging that any imputed missing material property rows are ≤ 5 % of total rows. The plan describes median imputation (Phase 3) but does not specify logging the imputation fraction or enforcing the ≤ 5 % threshold.
